description:
🚀 Welcome to SpaceHack!

We are a passionate team participating in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge under the Karwar Local Event.

Our mission is to bring forgotten space exploration history back to life through creativity, technology, research, and storytelling.

For the challenge "Abandoned but not Forgotten," we aim to explore NASA's discarded equipment on the Moon and Mars and transform their stories into an engaging, interactive digital experience.
summary:
Echoes of Space is an interactive digital storytelling project that explores abandoned and inactive space exploration equipment on the Moon and Mars.

Our project aims to bring attention to the forgotten machines, landers, rovers, and scientific equipment that helped humanity explore other worlds. Through engaging stories, visuals, mission information, and interactive content, users can discover the history and importance of these technologies.

The project connects space exploration with storytelling to explain why equipment was left behind, what scientific contributions it made, and how it continues to represent human innovation.

Our goal is to make space science more accessible, educational, and interesting, especially for students and young space enthusiasts.

By combining NASA resources, research, creativity, and technology, SpaceHack wants to turn forgotten space equipment into stories worth remembering.
details:
Project Overview

Echoes of Space: Forgotten Machines of the Moon and Mars is a digital storytelling initiative designed to document and share the stories of abandoned space exploration equipment.

How It Works

The project organizes information about historical lunar and Martian missions into an engaging digital experience. Users can explore equipment, learn about the missions behind it, discover why certain hardware remains on planetary surfaces, and understand its scientific and historical importance.

Key Features

  • Interactive exploration of forgotten lunar and Martian equipment.
  • Historical mission stories and equipment descriptions.
  • Educational information about NASA's space exploration missions.
  • Images and scientific information sourced from NASA resources.
  • An accessible storytelling experience for students and space enthusiasts.

Benefits and Impact

The project helps preserve the history of space exploration, increases awareness of scientific achievements, and makes planetary science easier to understand. It also encourages students to explore STEM subjects and appreciate the engineering behind space missions.

Technology and Tools

The implementation may use HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web development frameworks, data visualization tools, and digital design software, depending on the actual technologies used by the team.

Creativity and Innovation

Our creative approach combines scientific research, visual storytelling, and interactive learning to give forgotten space equipment a meaningful voice.

Future Scope

We aim to expand the project with 3D models, interactive planetary maps, additional mission records, and multilingual educational content.
